title: Graduate Customer Intelligence Executive - French Speaking
description: <p></p> <p>Fospha is the measurement system enterprise retail and ecommerce brands run their business on. We give marketing teams one clear, daily view of what's actually working — across every channel and everywhere they sell, from their website to Amazon and TikTok Shop — down to the level of a single ad or piece of creative. It replaces guesswork and gut feel with a number marketing, finance and agencies can all trust and act on.</p> <p>Brands including Dyson, Gymshark, Adanola and Huel use Fospha up to 25 times a day to decide where budget should move next. We've spent over a decade building this, with more than $40 billion in marketing spend now optimised through the platform — and we're scaling fast across London, Mumbai and Austin.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>About the role</strong></p> <p>The Customer Intelligence team are responsible for ensuring our customers take action on Fospha data: turning data into clear recommendations, guiding marketers through budgeting decisions and helping client teams become experts in the Fospha platform.</p> <p>This is the entry point into the function, and it is a hands-on one. You'll work across live customer accounts from the point that they go live with Fospha, becoming the trusted expert in the domain, our customers and the decisions they are making across their marketing mix. It's a role for someone who wants to learn how to turn data into customer action, in a business where these actions are meaningful and exciting.</p> <ul> <li><strong>Team</strong>: Customer Intelligence</li> <li><strong>Level</strong>: Graduate - Entry Level</li> <li><strong>Location</strong>: London, White City<br><br></li> </ul> <p><strong>What you’ll be doing:</strong></p> <ul> <li>You'll join our Customer Intelligence Team and work across customer accounts, becoming a trusted expert in the insight, model, and data quality that sit behind them</li> <li>You'll be responsible for the customer outcomes your team owns — driving action on insight, trust in the model, and confidence in data quality — contributing to customer retention alongside the Account Manager</li> <li>You'll build deep expertise in your specialism and use it to solve real customer problems, turning data into clear recommendations, building trust in our methodology, and keeping data accurate and flowing</li> <li>You'll be confident and effective in customer-facing moments relevant to your team, building credibility with both technical and non-technical stakeholders</li> <li>You'll be collaborative, working closely with Account Managers and other specialist teams, feeding customer insight back to Product, and keeping everyone aligned with regular progress updates</li> </ul> <p>In addition to your core responsibilities, we expect you to be excited by the opportunity Gen AI brings and find new ways of working utilising our Gen AI hub to increase our efficiency</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>The Centre of Excellence</strong></p> <ul> <li>The Centre of Excellence is Fospha's early-careers programme that develops ambitious, high-performing talent through focused training, hands-on experience and cross-functional exposure. Starting in Customer Intelligence, you'll gain foundational experience while being prepared for future opportunities across the organisation. The programme operates on the following principles:</li> <li>Individual Responsibility from the Get-go: You will quickly be responsible for the success of your work, able to make an individual impact early in your career</li> <li>Work alongside SLT at Leading Businesses: You will be engaging with Senior Leadership and C-Level executives at the leading retail brands, getting exposure to how the top companies operate</li> <li>Become a Customer Facing Expert: You will be working directly with customers, often meeting them in person and developing your ability to create strong interpersonal relationships</li> <li>Cross-Functional Exposure: we offer unique opportunities to learn from and collaborate with every department in the business — many daily</li> <li>Comprehensive Training: In addition to the extensive on-the-job learning opportunities, you'll receive a broad and blended in-person training curriculum covering essential topics such as Business Storytelling, Account Management, Market Research & Product and Financial Management</li> <li>Real Mentorship: Regular one-to-ones, feedback, and career conversations with people invested in your progression, not just your output</li> <li>Career Development: High performers have clear opportunities to quickly advance their careers at Fospha — whether progressing within our Customer Teams toward strategic and/or management roles or moving into other departments that align with your skills and interests</li> <li>Modern Tools: Hands-on exposure to Gen AI tooling through our Gen AI hub, so you're building modern, AI-fluent ways of working rather than legacy processes</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>What we can offer you</strong></p> <ul> <li>Salary: £34k + discretionary 10% bonus</li> <li>A workplace pension ~~through Royal London~~, with Fospha matching your contributions up to 3%</li> <li>A £1,000/year flexible benefits allowance to put towards private medical insurance, dental cover, a health cash plan, gym membership, extra holiday, or a pension top-up - whatever suits you!</li> <li>Access to Wellhub, giving you one membership across gyms, boutique studios, and wellbeing apps</li> <li>25 days' annual leave plus 8 UK bank holidays, an extra day off for your birthday! and more holiday the longer you stay (26 days after 3 years, 27 after 6)</li> <li>Life assurance worth 4x your annual salary, from day one</li> <li>Cycle to Work scheme, plus discounts on everyday spending through our benefits portal — Apple, Tesco, IKEA, M&S, Deliveroo, cinema tickets and more</li> <li>Quarterly one-to-one sessions with a financial adviser, plus access to payroll-deducted loans through Salary Finance</li> <li>Paid volunteering days each year</li> <li>Regular socials, free weekly snacks, and Lunch & Learn events at our Scale Space office, plus access to the wider Blenheim Chalcot community</li> <li>Opportunities to travel — including to our India and North America offices</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>What are we looking for?</strong></p> <ul> <li>We hire for potential – you don’t need a technical degree or marketing background. We’re looking for:</li> <li>Curious, proactive individuals who are keen to learn and grow</li> <li>Excellent verbal and written communication skills</li> <li>Strong relationship-building ability, both internally and externally</li> <li>Analytical mindset, comfortable interpreting data and creating insights – proficiency in Excel!</li> <li>Organised and able to manage multiple priorities simultaneously</li> <li>Solving problems for customers</li> <li>Interest in emerging technologies and excited by the potential and opportunity AI brings</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Our Values and Principles</strong></p> <ul> <li>You will be able to demonstrate examples of our core principles:</li> <li>Seek inclusion & diversity: We create an environment where everyone feels welcome, and people are encouraged to speak and be hear</li> <li>Work Hard, Work Well, Work Together: We take responsibility for making things happen, independently and together; we help colleagues in need and close loops, making sure our work is complete and has lasting impact</li> <li>Grow: We are proactive, curious and unafraid of failure</li> <li>Customer at the heart: We care about the customer, feel their pain and love building product that solves their biggest problems</li> <li>Candour with caring: We deliver candid feedback with kindness and receive it with gratitude</li> </ul> <p></p> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

They should be able to concisely and accurately share knowledge with their teammates.</span></p></div><h3 data-pm-slice="1 1 []"><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;">ABOUT THE ROLE:</span></h3> <p>We are seeking an experienced Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) Engineer focused on European Union and United Kingdom information security and financial services regulation to help scale compliance for SpaceXAI and xMoney. You will architect the systems and processes that automate trust — a pragmatic operator who understands that GRC exists to enable the business, balancing rigorous standards with the velocity of a high-growth company. The ideal candidate brings hands-on experience with frameworks such as DORA, the EU AI Act, NIS2, and related EU/UK information security and operational resilience obligations, plus GRC engineering skills: Compliance-as-Code, continuous evidence collection, and deep partnership with engineering so controls are designed into the platform rather than bolted on after the fact.</p> <p><em>This role may also include additional tasks and responsibilities as needed to support the team and evolving business priorities. This position may require occasional travel.</em></p> <h3><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;">RESPONSIBILITIES:</span></h3> <ul> <li>Own and evolve EU/UK financial services and digital operational resilience posture across DORA (including ICT risk management, incident reporting, resilience testing, and third-party ICT provider oversight), and complementary expectations from EBA/ESMA/EIOPA guidance, PSD2/PSR where applicable, and UK PRA/FCA operational resilience requirements supporting xMoney.</li> <li>Build and maintain Compliance-as-Code capabilities — policy-as-code, automated control validation, continuous evidence collection, and monitoring integrated into CI/CD — so audit and supervisory readiness scales with the business rather than depending on manual, point-in-time checks.</li> <li>Operate and extend GRC platforms (e.g., Vanta) as the backbone for control mapping, evidence management, and continuous compliance; integrate with cloud, identity, logging, and engineering systems to reduce administrative bottlenecks.</li> <li>Partner with Architects and Engineering Leads to bake EU/UK information security and regulatory requirements into design early; translate complex obligations into concrete technical implementations and auditor- or supervisor-ready narratives without slowing development.</li> <li>Design, implement, and validate technical information security controls relevant to regulated EU/UK environments (access control, logging and monitoring, encryption, change management, vulnerability management, ICT third-party oversight, and secure SDLC) — not just document them.</li> <li>Operate the cybersecurity and compliance risk register — identify, quantify, and track risks, distinguishing theoretical gaps from meaningful business and regulatory risk under EU/UK supervisory expectations.</li> <li>Lead information security risk assessments and compliance reviews for new products, features, vendors, and architectural changes that affect the EU/UK regulated attack surface, including ICT third-party / critical provider diligence aligned to DORA.</li> <li>Liaise with the Data Privacy team on security-relevant intersections (e.g., security measures supporting confidentiality and integrity.</li> <li>Own and cultivate relationships with external auditors, assessors, and (where applicable) supervisory contacts on information security topics; serve as the bridge between external parties and internal teams so requests are reasonable, clear, and relevant to our stack.</li> <li>Develop, maintain, and continuously improve information security policies, standards, and procedures aligned to DORA, the EU AI Act, NIS2 where in scope, and complementary frameworks (e.g., ISO 27001, SOC 2) where they overlap.</li> <li>Champion pragmatic governance — prioritize issues that represent real security or business risk over checkbox compliance.</li> </ul> <h3><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;">BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</span></h3> <ul> <li>Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Security, Cybersecurity, or in an engineering/STEM field.</li> <li>8+ years of experience in GRC, information security compliance, or technology audit roles in fintech, banking, payments, or other heavily regulated environments with EU and/or UK exposure.</li> <li>Hands-on experience implementing or operating controls against several of the following: DORA, the EU AI Act, NIS2, PSD2/PSR, or UK PRA/FCA operational resilience expectations — not only reading the requirements.</li> <li>Familiar with data privacy regulations applicable to the EU/UK region (e.g., EU GDPR, UK GDPR, UK Data Protection Act 2018) sufficient to liaise with Privacy counterparts.</li> <li>Experience with Compliance-as-Code practices and GRC automation tooling (e.g., Vanta, or similar), with a bias toward continuous monitoring and reducing manual evidence collection.</li> <li>Technical fluency sufficient to speak the language of engineering, On-premises, hybrid, or cloud (AWS/GCP/Azure), and security architecture, and to anticipate how design decisions impact information security risk and compliance.</li> </ul> <h3><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;">PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:</span></h3> <ul> <li>10+ years of information security compliance, GRC engineering, or technology audit-related experience in fintech or financial services with a primary EU/UK focus.</li> <li>Hands-on experience implementing technical controls (e.g., IAM, logging and monitoring, encryption, network segmentation, infrastructure hardening) and integrating compliance checks into CI/CD pipelines.</li> <li>Experience supporting ISO 27001 and/or SOC 2 programs alongside EU/UK regulatory obligations.</li> <li>Familiar with GDPR concepts that commonly intersect with information security (e.g., security of processing, breach notification timelines, encryption/pseudonymization as security measures) when collaborating with DPO/Legal/Privacy functions.</li> <li>Familiarity with DORA ICT third-party risk, register of information, threat-led penetration testing (TLPT) concepts, and major ICT-related incident reporting expectations.</li> <li>Experience with AI governance under the EU AI Act or related national guidance, especially security controls for AI features in regulated financial products.</li> <li>Familiar with related regional regimes that may touch information security scope (e.g., ePrivacy, Digital Services Act touchpoints, MiCA where relevant to product scope, or FCA Consumer Duty technology implications).</li> <li>Experience enabling enterprise sales through trust centers, vendor questionnaires, and customer security reviews for EU/UK buyers.</li> <li>Proven ability to operate a risk register and apply judgment in gray areas — focusing on outcomes over optics.</li> <li>Exceptional analytical, problem-solving, organizational, and project management skills, with the ability to take compliance programs from conception to assessment-ready launch.</li> <li>Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills — able to explain information security and regulatory requirements to engineers, legal, privacy, sales, and executives in plain language.</li> <li>Certifications such as CISSP, CISA, CISM, CRISC, ISO 27001 Lead Implementer/Auditor, or similar preferred; are a plus for liaison fluency, not a substitute for security depth.</li> <li>Prior experience working with or within EU/UK-regulated financial institutions, EMI/PI environments, or supervised fintechs is a plus.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><em>SpaceXAI is an equal opportunity employer. title: Senior Partner Marketing Manager - EMEA
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Fastly helps people stay better connected with the things they love. Fastly’s edge cloud platform enables customers to create great digital experiences quickly, securely, and reliably by processing, serving, and securing our customers’ applications as close to their end-users as possible — at the edge of the Internet. The platform is designed to take advantage of the modern internet, to be programmable, and to support agile software development. Fastly’s customers include many of the world’s most prominent companies, including GitHub, Yelp, Paramount, and JetBlue.</p> <p>We're building a more trustworthy Internet. Come join us.</p></div><p><strong>Senior Partner Marketing Manager, EMEA </strong></p> <p>Come join the team that’s building our partners’ growth engine. Right now, we are executing a critical strategic transition from a legacy direct-led approach to one made up of high-velocity, specialized ecosystem partners. As the Senior Regional Partner Marketing Manager, you are not here to distribute brochures, manage a portal graveyard, or chase passive deal registrations. You are an Ecosystem Growth Architect. </p> <p>Based in London and reporting directly to the Director of Global Partner Marketing (US-based), your mission is to treat co-marketing as an economic multiplier, laser-targeting premium MSSPs, security VARs, and GSIs across our priority regional territories while showing them how to become a high-margin services business using Fastly. </p> <p><strong>What You'll Do:</strong></p> <ul> <li> <p>Drive Pipeline Through/With Partners: Drive incremental, high-intent pipeline coverage across targeted EMEA market segments to directly address regional pipeline deficits, working closely with both Channel Account Managers and Territory Sales. </p> </li> <li> <p>Activate the Partner Demand-gen Engine: Act as the regional demand-generation subject matter expert, architecting and launching end-to-end partner marketing campaigns that activate the ecosystem co-marketing flywheel.</p> </li> <li> <p>Market the Services Revenue Multiplier: Demonstrate to partners how Fastly can serve as the engine for their own high-margin services business through GTM value proposition and high-impact joint marketing engagements.    </p> </li> <li> regional programs with the blueprint to scale globally.</p> </li> <li> <p>Act as a High-Agency Owner: Bring a proactive, builder-marketer mindset to this foundational role, with the autonomy to shape our EMEA partner marketing framework and adapt strategies as our regional footprint grows.</p> </li> </ul> <p><strong>What We're Looking For</strong></p> <p><strong><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Basic Qualifications</span></strong>:</p> <ul> <li> <p>8+ years of B2B technology marketing experience, with a minimum of 4 years dedicated specifically to channel, distributor, or partner ecosystem marketing within the SaaS, cloud infrastructure, or cyber-security sectors.</p> </li> <li> <p>Proven experience collaborating with specialized two-tier distribution frameworks or premier security VARs and GSIs across EMEA.</p> </li> <li> <p>Demonstrated success building and executing co-marketing frameworks that drive measurable enterprise pipeline growth.</p> </li> <li> <p>Strong written and verbal communication skills; based in London with a track record of successfully working across global, distributed cross-functional teams.</p> </li> <li> <p>You have an interest in independently and proactively running multiple projects in a dynamic environment using superior project management skills </p> </li> <li> <p>You have knowledge of specific regional considerations in (particularly French) is highly advantageous.</p> </li> </ul> <p><strong>Work Location(s) & Travel Requirements</strong></p> <div> <p>This position is based out of Fastly’s London, UK office.  Fastly currently embraces a largely hybrid model for most roles which allows employees flexibility to split their time between the office and home. </p> <p>This position may require travel as required by your role or requested by your manager.</p> </div> <p><strong>Work Hours:</strong> This position will require you to be available during core business hours 9:00-18:00 with some flexibility due to timezones.</p> <p><strong>Benefits</strong></p> <p>We care about you. description: <p>Senior Product Manager</p> <p><strong>Location:</strong> UK (remote)</p> <h1><strong>Job Description</strong></h1> <h2><strong>About Us</strong></h2> <p>Reachdesk is the first truly end-to-end global SaaS gifting and swag platform, helping B2B companies create meaningful connections with prospects, customers, and employees, while driving measurable ROI.</p> <p>We believe gifting is more than just a transaction: it’s about building genuine human connections that fuel business growth. Whether it’s engaging prospects, celebrating customers, or recognizing employees, our platform makes it easy to deliver personalized gifts, branded swag, and unforgettable event & brand experiences at scale through automated sourcing, storage, and global delivery.</p> <p>Trusted by many of the most recognized names in technology and SaaS, Reachdesk integrates effortlessly with marketing, sales, and HRIS tech stacks and is powered by our world-class team across New York, London, and Lisbon.</p> <p>We’re growing, and we’re currently looking for a Senior Product Manager to join us.</p> <p> </p> <h2><strong>About the Role</strong></h2> <p>As a Senior Product Manager at Reachdesk, you’ll play a pivotal role in shaping the Reachdesk Platform. You will be accountable for turning complex customer and business problems into software products that deliver measurable impact.</p> <p>Reporting to the Chief Product Officer, you’ll lead product initiatives end-to-end,  from identifying and deeply understanding the right problems to solve, through discovery and delivery, to launch, adoption, and continuous improvement.</p> <p>You’ll operate with a high degree of autonomy, proactively building context across customers, the market, internal stakeholders, data, and technology to understand what Reachdesk needs to achieve its goals. You’ll also make sound decisions when the path forward isn’t obvious.</p> <p>You’ll partner closely with Engineering and Design and work across the wider business to create alignment, communicate decisions clearly, and ensure what we build is successfully launched, adopted, and delivers the outcomes we set out to achieve.</p> <p>If you enjoy solving difficult problems, taking ownership, and moving comfortably between customer, technical, and business conversations, you’ll thrive in this role.</p> <p> </p> <h2><strong>Responsibilities</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Set product direction and priorities</strong>, bringing together company goals, internal stakeholder needs, customer insight, market context, data, and technical considerations to focus on the highest-impact opportunities.</li> <li><strong>Define problems and experiences before solutions</strong>, creating clear stories, journeys, and shared context so the Design and Engineering teams understand the problem and intended outcomes before determining the solution.</li> <li><strong>Lead product initiatives end-to-end</strong>, from discovery and solution definition through delivery, rollout, and iteration, partnering with Engineering to manage scope, make pragmatic trade-offs, and deliver valuable solutions at pace.</li> <li><strong>Make sound product decisions and trade-offs</strong>, balancing customer and business needs, commercial impact, user experience, and technical considerations while aligning the wider business on compromises, priorities, and expectations.</li> <li><strong>Develop product opportunities with external partners</strong>, building relationships with technology partners to uncover mutual opportunities, shape integrations, align roadmaps, and navigate the product and commercial considerations required to bring them to market.</li> <li><strong>Orchestrate successful launches and adoption</strong>, working across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Services, Logistics, Finance, Legal, and other teams to ensure the business is ready and customers realise value from what we build.</li> <li><strong>Communicate with clarity throughout</strong>, ensuring leadership and teams across Reachdesk understand product decisions, progress, risks, changes, and results.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h2><strong>About you</strong></h2> <ul> <li>You have a strong track record of <strong>owning B2B SaaS products end-to-end</strong>, from identifying the right problems through delivery, adoption, and measurable customer and business outcomes.</li> <li>You’re a <strong>strong problem solver</strong> who gets to the root of complex problems, brings structure to ambiguity, and uses evidence and judgement to determine the right path forward.</li> <li>You operate with <strong>independence and initiative</strong>: you seek out the customers, stakeholders, data, and context you need rather than waiting for direction, while staying anchored to Reachdesk’s goals and priorities.</li> <li>You have <strong>strong business and commercial awareness</strong> and are curious about how the wider company operates, allowing you to understand competing needs and make pragmatic decisions beyond the boundaries of Product.</li> <li>You’re <strong>technically fluent enough to work effectively with Engineering</strong>, understand systems, integrations, and constraints, ask the right questions, and contribute meaningfully to solution and scope decisions.</li> <li>You’re an <strong>exceptional communicator</strong>, able to create clarity, influence decisions, surface difficult trade-offs, and adapt how you communicate across customers, engineers, leadership, and teams throughout the business.</li> <li>You’re comfortable <strong>operating externally as well as internally</strong>, building productive relationships with technology partners, uncovering shared opportunities, influencing without authority, and navigating product, technical, and commercial conversations.</li> <li>You have a strong sense of <strong>product and user experience</strong>, caring about the coherence and quality of the complete experience rather than whether individual requirements or features have simply been delivered.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h2><strong>The benefits</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Competitive salary with generous stock options</li> <li>Pension with employer contributions (NEST)</li> <li>Affordable Private Medical Insurance, including mental health support and fast access to care</li> <li>Flexible PTO that increases the longer you’re with us, plus extra flexibility for life’s unexpected moments</li> <li>A genuinely collaborative culture with innovative, fun, and ambitious people</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p>Reachdesk believes that a diverse team helps us achieve our mission faster, and so we welcome applicants from all backgrounds. </p> <p><br>Privacy Policy: We process personal information submitted as part of your application in accordance with the Reachdesk Candidate Privacy Notice. Please review Reachdesk’s Privacy Policy here: <a href="http://www.reachdesk.com/candidate-privacy-policy">www.reachdesk.com/candidate-privacy-policy</a></p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Principal Data Scientist
description: At CoMind, we are developing a non-invasive neuromonitoring technology that will result in a new era of clinical brain monitoring. In joining us, you will be helping to create cutting-edge technologies that will improve how we diagnose and treat brain disorders, ultimately improving and saving the lives of patients across the world. The Role The Data Science team at CoMind develops the algorithms and machine learning systems that transform raw optical interference signals from CoMind One into continuous, clinically meaningful measurements of cerebral blood flow, intracranial pressure, and autoregulation. Working at the frontier of photonics, physiology, and applied ML, the team's work directly determines what CoMind One can measure, how accurately, and under what clinical conditions. As Principal Data Scientist, you will be a technical authority for CoMind's data science function, setting methodological direction for signal condition and extraction, personally driving the most complex and highest-impact problems, and providing expert guidance on data science best practice across the team. This is a senior individual contributor role: you will not manage people directly, but your technical leadership will shape how the entire team approaches its most challenging problems. You will work closely with R&D, Clinical, and Software Engineering. At CoMind, all team members work at least 4 days per week from our new Kings Cross offices, plus a flexible work-from-home day. Responsibilities: Act as the technical authority for the end-to-end signal processing and inference chain for CoMind’s technologies: from raw optical data through to clinical measurements Set the methodological direction for estimation, signal extraction and ML modelling across the team: which approaches suit which problems, how they are evaluated, and what evidence is required before a method is trusted. Own signal processing and analysis programmes from research through to validated, production-quality implementations with Software Engineering. Derive achievable performance bounds from instrument and noise models, and use them to drive algorithm selection, requirement setting and design trade-offs Own how the team handles uncertainty and calibration — inference methods appropriate to small clinical cohorts, per-patient estimation with quantified uncertainty, and calibration strategies that make measurements comparable across devices, sessions and patients. Set the standard for how the data science function works: reproducibility, analysis and code review, experiment design, dataset governance and ground-truth definitions Act as the primary technical reviewer and expert resource across the research organisation, reviewing technical reports, analysis plans and evaluation methodology, and holding the bar for methodological rigour and scientific integrity. Identify and introduce new, best-practice methods from estimation, inference and measurement science in adjacent fields. Act as a mentor to members of the Data Science teams and across the wider business Contribute to CoMind's IP and publication strategy, authoring and reviewing technical papers, patent applications and regulatory documents. AI is fundamental to our culture. It's not just a tool, but a core part of how we work, collaborate, and innovate. We expect all team members to embrace AI in their daily work and continuously find new ways to use it effectively. Skills & Experience: 15+ years of experience in data science, ML, or applied research, with a strong track record of independent technical leadership on complex, ambiguous problems A career working to extract small signals from noisy, complex physiological systems, and developing and deploying physical models of those systems to support those efforts. Deep expertise in physiological time-series signal processing methodologies. A demonstrated ability to take algorithmic work from research concept through to production-quality, validated implementations in shipped product. Designing device performance evaluation methods where no prior gold-standard exists: simulating physical systems, running sensitivity analysis, identifying failure modes, and developing signal processing solutions to address those challenges. Extensive experience owning calibration and cross-instrument comparability work that involved noise models, error budgets, and evaluation of experimental data Strong record of scientific output: publications, patents, or equivalent evidence of original technical contribution and domain authority Nice to Have: Background in neuroscience, neuromonitoring, or cerebrovascular physiology Experience with optical signal processing - e.g. LiDAR, pulse oximetry, NIRS, laser doppler flowmetry, or related technologies Experience in a regulated industry (medical devices, diagnostics, pharma, or similar), with familiarity of algorithm validation and documentation requirements for software as a medical device Benefits: Company equity plan so all employees share in the success of the company Salary-sacrifice pension scheme Private medical, dental and vision insurance (medical history disregarded) Group life assurance at 4x annual income Comprehensive mental health support, including unlimited access to 1:1 sessions with trained professionals Unlimited holiday allowance (+ bank holidays) and one week of remote working per quarter Lunch voucher (£10) every day for JustEat and free dinner on those days where you need to work later Twice weekly deliveries of fresh fruit and an extensive selection of snacks and drinks YuLife subscription, allowing you to turn your daily steps and meditation into discounts at a range of stores Access to Udemy for upskilling and professional development Disclaimer - We use Granola, an AI notetaker, throughout our interview process to help capture notes. It's used only for note-taking during the conversation. Transcripts aren't saved to shared drives or stored externally. Let us know if you'd prefer we don't. title: Machine Learning Engineer
description: We pull medical technology from the future to solve human health. Scarlet is authorised to assess and certify medical devices. We combine clinical, technical and regulatory expertise with AI agents and software so rigorous certification can keep pace with product development at the world’s most ambitious technology companies, without lowering the safety bar. Our customers have cut a year or more from their certification timelines for new AI-enabled medical devices and shortened product-update cycles from months to weeks. You’ll join a team building the infrastructure that makes these outcomes repeatable at scale. About the role The Applied Machine Learning team owns production systems and pursues new ideas, from conception and prototyping through to deployment, evaluation and iterative improvement. Working with clinicians, assessors and engineers, we build reliable ML systems that help bring medical devices to market faster, without compromising safety. It’s a domain rich in text, data and expert judgment, with little precedent for much of what we’re building. You’ll own meaningful problems in how we assess medical devices: define success with domain experts, decide what to build and test, and take ML systems through deployment and measurable improvement in production. Responsibilities Things you might work on: Agentic document understanding – Build agents that search, parse and visually inspect messy technical files: scanned certificates, tables, architecture diagrams and thousands of pages of evidence. Find what matters and show exactly where it came from. Harnesses built for evidence – Develop custom agent harnesses for retrieving information across large document collections in varied formats. Preserve source attribution, minimise hallucination, and make deliberate trade-offs between accuracy, latency and cost. Deploy to production. Evals wired into real workflows – Define success with assessors and build datasets and benchmarks that capture a complex, nuanced domain. Measure retrieval quality, citation correctness and agreement with expert judgment alongside the impact on assessor effort, assessment quality and customer experience, including rework. Use the results to choose what to improve next. Applied AI alignment – Build useful agents that respect the impartiality and objectivity required of a certification body. Help people understand the evidence, recognise uncertainty and retain responsibility for consequential judgments. Who you are Creator of datasets – You roll up your sleeves and build the dataset you wish existed, rather than wait for someone else to give you one. Establisher of evals – You think from first principles about statistics and evaluating ML systems. You're suspicious of benchmarks that don't match reality. Builder of agent systems – You understand deep-learning, agent tools, context management and information retrieval, and how they interact. Shipper of software – 3+ years shipping software to production. You own deployment, monitoring and the investigation when something breaks. Security judgment – You’ve made and implemented pragmatic security decisions for production systems. You can reason about data access, permissions, untrusted inputs and actions with real consequences; design proportionate mitigations; and recognise when specialist review is needed. Systems design – You’ve designed, deployed and operated production systems. You can choose infrastructure that fits the workload, explain the trade-offs in complexity, reliability, security and cost, and work within shared engineering standards. Hacker – You take ambitious projects from concept to reality with whatever tools are at hand. You experiment, measure and change your mind. Builder – You're insatiably curious about real-world problems and care that what you build has clear economic and human value. Owner of ambiguous problems – You can point to an ambiguous problem you owned: working directly with domain experts to define success, choosing what to try, and following it through experiments and production to measurable improvement. Preferred qualifications Experience deploying agent systems with tool use, sensitive data or consequential actions, including evaluating their behaviour and designing safeguards. Experience building retrieval or document-understanding systems whose outputs must be checked against complex source evidence. title: People Analytics Analyst
description: People Analytics Analyst About Us ClearBank is a technology-enabled bank built to help transform banking and payments. We combine banking expertise and technology to provide infrastructure that enables our clients to deliver innovative financial products and services. Our culture is founded on trust, accountability, learning, collaboration and the confidence to challenge established ways of working responsibly. We built ClearBank on the belief that banking infrastructure would no longer slow down progress. Instead, it would be a catalyst that unlocks the potential to innovate. It would adapt to different needs so a new era in financial services could begin. We’re here to challenge the status quo in banking, are you? We all know that transforming banking forever is not an easy mission, but we’re more than ready to rise to that challenge. We all do it every day; navigating new, unexpected and sometimes even daunting challenges. But we believe in ourselves and trust we can do it. Want to innovate? Go for it. Push for a better way? You Can. If you think you have it in you, this is Where You Can. The role: Reporting to our Head of Reward, as the People Analytics Analyst you will help the People Team make informed, evidence-led decisions by turning data into clear, accurate and actionable insight. Working across the People Team you will deliver reporting and analysis that supports organisational effectiveness, particularly focusing on Reward and People Operations among the wider team. You will strengthen data quality, reporting controls and analytical capability across the People function, making insight easier to understand and use while protecting the confidentiality of employee information. Key Responsibilities Produce regular and ad hoc people reporting that gives stakeholders a clear view of workforce trends, risks and opportunities. Analyse data across the employee lifecycle, including workforce composition, recruitment, retention, progression, performance, absence, engagement and inclusion. Develop accessible dashboards, reports and visualisations that turn complex data into clear insights for People and business stakeholders. Partner with Reward to support pay benchmarking, reward reviews, pay-positioning analysis and other compensation-related activity through accurate data preparation and analysis. Maintain accurate and consistent people datasets, including clear data definitions, validation checks, reconciliation, documentation and version control. Investigate data anomalies and work with People, Finance, Payroll and other stakeholders to resolve root causes and improve source-data quality. Support workforce planning and organisational analysis by identifying patterns, modelling scenarios and presenting evidence-based observations. Provide analytical support for People projects and recurring processes, ensuring outputs are accurate, timely and appropriate for their intended audience. Improve reporting processes through automation, standardisation and the reduction of unnecessary manual activity. Promote responsible use of people data by applying appropriate confidentiality, access, governance and quality controls. What success looks like in the role: Stakeholders receive accurate, timely and decision-ready people insights that help them understand workforce priorities and take appropriate action. Core People reporting is supported by clear definitions, effective controls and reliable data that stakeholders trust. People analytics increasingly covers the wider employee lifecycle, while Reward receives consistent and high-quality analytical support. Recurring reports and processes become more efficient, scalable and easier to use through thoughtful automation and standardisation. Complex findings are communicated clearly, with appropriate context, enabling stakeholders to understand both the evidence and its limitations. Skills & Experience: Experience in people analytics, HR reporting, workforce analytics, business analysis or another data-focused role. Strong analytical and numerical skills, including experience working with detailed or complex datasets. Ability to translate analysis into concise insights, clear visual outputs and practical recommendations. Strong Excel capability, including formulas, data validation, reconciliation, data manipulation and structured analysis. Use or advocacy of AI is welcome. Experience producing recurring reports, dashboards or management information for different stakeholder groups. Strong attention to detail and a consistent approach to checking, documenting and controlling analytical outputs. Understanding of data quality, confidentiality and the responsible handling of sensitive employee information. Ability to investigate anomalies, identify root causes and work collaboratively with others to resolve data issues. Strong planning and organisational skills, with the ability to manage recurring reporting alongside ad hoc analytical requests. Clear communication and stakeholder-management skills, including the ability to explain analytical findings to non-technical audiences. Nice-to-have Experience working within a People or HR function in a regulated organisation, financial-services business or technology company. Familiarity with HR information systems, reporting platforms or data-visualisation tools. Experience supporting workforce planning, organisational design, employee-listening or inclusion analysis. Exposure to reward analytics, salary benchmarking, pay-review modelling or compensation data. Experience improving or automating reporting and data processes. Ways of Working & Culture Care like we mean it: Handle people data with care, respect and discretion, while producing insight that considers its impact on colleagues and the organisation. Build trust together: Take ownership of data quality and delivery, follow through on commitments, exercise sound judgement and raise risks or limitations early. Grow with the challenge: Stay curious, seek feedback and build analytical capability while adapting to changing priorities and new questions. Succeed as one: Work collaboratively across People, Reward, Finance, Payroll and the wider business, engaging stakeholders early and focusing on shared outcomes. Clear a bold new path: Challenge inefficient reporting practices, test better approaches and build solutions that can scale as the organisation’s analytical needs evolve. Role Level: 2 If this sounds like you then we encourage you to dust off that CV and apply! *Please note that we are not currently able to sponsor applicants for immigration purposes. A little bit more about us! ClearBank is Where You Can belong: At ClearBank we think about Diversity, Equity and Inclusion (DE&I) a lot. Not because we think we should. But because we know we should – how else can we build a happy workforce and be successful as a business. We’re committed to making sure our teams reflect society. And we put energy and effort into making this a place where everyone feels at home, where they’re given the trust and encouragement to do their very best work. Here are some of the things we’re most proud of: 42% of our senior management roles are held by women Our enhanced family leave policies Launching our partnership with Code First Girls Increasing awareness of neurodiversity in the workplace through our partnership with the Inclusive Group Our hiring process and what you can expect: Application: a member of our talent acquisition team will review your application against the key requirements for the role and let you know within two weeks whether you’re moving forward to the next stage; Screening: You’ll spend 30-45 minutes speaking to one of our recruiters learning more about the role and ClearBank, and we’ll get it know more about you, your experience and how your skills align with the role (this will be via phone or Teams video call). You can expect to hear back from us within seven days following this meeting (if things are taking longer than expected, we’ll let you know that too); First Interview: You’ll spend one hour with a member of our hiring team focusing on your skills, competencies and your ways of working at the same time we’ll give you time to ask more questions about the role, the team and learn more about the ClearBank culture. This will be via Teams. Second Interview: This will be a competency-based interview with one or more members of our team. Final Stage: You will have a final meeting with the Head of Department. This will be around 45-60 minutes. Offer: Congratulations! Get ready to transform banking forever! Our commitment to you as a candidate: We will always try our best to get back to you within seven days of your interview whether you’ve been successful or not and provide you with feedback. Sometimes things take a little longer, so we may not have a decision to share but we will get it touch to let you know we need a little more time. We’re unable to provide specific individual feedback at the application or screening stage but know that your application was reviewed and considered carefully. We wish you the best of luck with your application and maybe we’ll be celebrating your new role at ClearBank soon! Equal Opportunities ClearBank is committed to ensuring equal opportunities throughout every stage of the recruitment process. ClearBank recognises that diversity is vital to the long-term success of the business in the communities and markets in which it operates. ClearBank is also a firm believer that an inclusive culture fosters greater employee engagement and collaboration. ClearBank strives for diversity and inclusion of all forms, including (but not limited to): gender, age, educational and professional background, disability, gender reassignment, marital or civil partner status, pregnancy or maternity, race, colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin, religion or belief and sexual orientation. As part of the Company’s commitment to equal employment opportunity, we provide reasonable adjustments, to candidates during the recruitment process, including to individuals with disabilities. We want to create a safe space that welcomes everyone so please let us know how we can accommodate you. In case you have any accessibility requirements you can share that with our Talent Acquisition team prior to your interview stage, if applicable. The legal bit By submitting your CV to ClearBank Limited you are providing your consent for us to use the information you provide for recruitment purposes. For more information on how we manage your data go and check out our Candidate Privacy Notice on the ClearBank website to see how we process, manage and look after your data. You are also allowing us to communicate with you by email and telephone for recruitment purposes. Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Director of Communications – International Shows (Touring & Resident)
description: ***Le poste étant basé en Angleterre, la description de poste est disponible uniquement en anglais.*** ***As this position in based in England, the job description is available in English only.*** _________________________________________________ Director of Communications – International Shows (Touring & Resident) Sales, Marketing and Communications Full-Time Position Reports to: Reports to Vice President - Commercial, Europe, Middle East and Asia with a functional reporting line to SVP, Communication Scope: All international shows outside the Americas (Europe, UK, Middle East, Africa, Asia-Pacific & Oceania) + Public Affairs Teams: Touring show PR teams (embedded on tour) + Resident show PR teams, and their respective agency rosters Role Purpose The Director of Communications – International Shows (Touring & Resident) is responsible for driving demand, building anticipation, and ensuring cultural relevance for Cirque du Soleil’s shows across all markets outside the Americas. This role elevates show communications into a strategic growth engine , integrating PR, earned media, and public affairs to create urgency, unlock market opportunities, and support commercial performance across every international production. Based in London, this role acts as the central show communications and public affairs lead for international markets , ensuring alignment between show storytelling, market-level marketing plans, and cross-functional execution across multiple time zones, languages, and regulatory environments. Core Mission Drive anticipation, urgency, and sustained demand for international touring and resident shows Make communications a core lever of the show marketing mix , fully integrated with paid, CRM, and ticketing Lead, develop, and set standards for the touring and resident show PR teams and the agencies that support them Own the strategy and governance of show-specific social media channels as an earned and owned demand driver Leverage public affairs as a growth enabler to unlock market access, market entry, and partnerships Ensure communications is a core driver of ticket revenue and brand equity outside the Americas Orchestrate cross-functional alignment to deliver cohesive show launches across diverse international markets Key Responsibilities 1. Show Communications Strategy – International Touring, Resident Shows & Public Affairs Lead and oversee an international show communications strategy spanning touring productions, resident shows, and public affairs Embed communications within the end-to-end demand engine (onsale → launch → sustain), in lockstep with market marketing plans Integrate public affairs into market entry and growth strategies for new territories Lead communications strategy in support of sponsorships and business development, including building relationships with key stakeholders, and developing joint communication plans with partners 2. Show Communications Leadership (Europe, UK, Middle East, Africa, APAC & Oceania) Own communications strategy and performance across all international touring and resident productions Ensure each show delivers: Clear, differentiated narrative Strong local and cultural relevance, adapted per market and language Full lifecycle comms (pre-onsale → launch → sustain) Implement standards, playbooks, and governance that scale across markets and local agency partners Act as spokesperson for international shows and manage show-level issues in market, escalating to corporate communications at HQ where required 3. Show-Specific Social Media Ownership Ensure each show PR team owns the strategy, management, and community engagement for its show-specific social media channels Set the content, tone, and publishing standards that keep show channels distinctive while consistent with the masterbrand Align show channel activity to the onsale, launch, and sustain calendar in each market Drive creator, influencer, and talent-led content through show channels to build cultural relevance and organic reach Set and track channel performance measures (growth, engagement, referral to ticketing) alongside earned media KPIs Ensure coordination with central brand and social teams on shared assets, escalation paths, and community management protocols 4. Public Affairs & Stakeholder Engagement Leverage public affairs as a strategic growth enabler by building relationships with: Government and public sector stakeholders across international markets Tourism boards, city partners, venues, and cultural institutions Unlock opportunities to: Support market entry for touring and resident shows Facilitate partnerships and local integration Strengthen Cirque du Soleil’s institutional influence outside the Americas Coordinate closely with internal stakeholders to align on regulatory, reputational, and market access considerations , including visas, work permits, and cross-border touring requirements 5. Cross-Functional Orchestration Own coordination across non-marketing functions to ensure aligned execution and messaging around shows, including: Legal HR (incl. talent mobility, immigration) Sustainability Operations Sponsorship & partnerships Act as the central orchestrator ensuring communications supports and amplifies show and market decisions Ensure consistency between internal decisions, external messaging, and market execution , and act as the two-way bridge between international markets and HQ 6. Cultural Relevance & Media Impact Position Cirque du Soleil’s shows as culturally relevant and premium in international markets Build relationships with Tier 1 media, creators, and influencers across the UK, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific Activate cultural moments and partnerships tied to international show launches and runs 7. Team Leadership, Agency Governance & Performance Lead and develop the PR teams embedded with the touring shows and the PR teams responsible for the resident shows , across multiple markets, time zones, and languages Build a consistent operating model, capability plan, and career path across both team groups, including onboarding for new tours and openings Approve and sign off on all agency appointments, scopes, and budgets proposed by the touring and resident show PR teams Define and manage the international agency ecosystem , setting selection criteria, performance standards, and review cadence Set KPIs tied to business impact (demand, awareness, launch momentum, ticket sales, social channel performance) Partner with marketing and analytics to link comms and social to revenue outcomes Profile & Experience Required 10+ years in communications/PR with multi-market, international leadership experience Proven ability to operate communications as a growth and demand lever tied to sales outcomes Strong experience in consumer, brand, or entertainment PR , ideally with campaign or launch ownership Experience working with government or public sector stakeholders in international markets Deep media relationships across the UK and Europe , with demonstrated reach into additional international markets Experience directly leading distributed, multi-time-zone in-house teams , including teams embedded with touring operations Proven track record appointing, contracting, and managing PR agencies across multiple markets Strong command of organic social media strategy and community management for consumer or entertainment brands Ability to operate in a matrixed, cross-functional environment with a North America–based headquarters Fluent in English (mandatory) ; willingness to travel frequently across international markets Preferred Additional language(s) relevant to key international markets (e.g. French, Spanish, German, Arabic, Japanese, Mandarin) Experience in entertainment, touring productions, live events, or premium brands Strong understanding of how communications integrates with marketing, CRM, and revenue generation Cirque du Soleil Entertainment Group is committed to creating and maintaining an accessible and inclusive workplace. title: Senior Data Scientist, Payment Intelligence
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3><strong>About us</strong></h3> <p>GoCardless, a Mollie company, is a global leader in bank payments. Over 100,000 businesses, from start-ups to household names, use GoCardless to collect, manage and send bank payments through Direct Debit, real-time payments and open banking. With US$130bn+ processed annually across 30+ countries, we handle recurring and one-off payments without the chasing, stress, or expensive fees. Our end-to-end payment platform also features AI-powered solutions to improve payment success and reduce fraud, alongside connections to over 350 platforms businesses use everyday.<br><br>We are headquartered in the UK, with teams and operations spanning North America, Europe and Asia-Pacific.  For more information, please visit<span><a href="http://www.gocardless.com" target="_blank"> www.gocardless.com</a></span> and follow us on LinkedIn<span><a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/gocardless" target="_blank"> ----- is the leading payments and financial services partner for business, rooted in Europe, with global reach.</p></div><h3>The role</h3> <p>Data sits at the core of our mission. We leverage bank account data to deliver high-value, intelligent payment solutions for our customers, from enhancing payment success rates to driving payer fraud prevention.</p> <p>As a Senior Data Scientist within our Payment Intelligence team, you’ll partner with Software Engineers, Product Managers, and Designers to turn big ideas into reality. You’ll own the full lifecycle of our algorithms, shaping everything from the initial concept to production-ready code that powers our global payment network.</p> <p>At GoCardless, our stack is centered around Google Cloud Platform and Vertex AI, providing a high-performance environment for innovation. Our Data Scientists operate at the intersection of Python, SQL, and BigQuery to build and deploy high-performance models at scale.</p> <h3><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Lead the end-to-end delivery of models at scale, from initial discovery and feature engineering to production, A/B testing and continuous monitoring.</li> <li>Collaborate with product and engineering peers to turn complex data into real-time, mission-critical fraud prevention solutions.</li> <li>Raise the team’s collective bar through hands-on technical leadership and knowledge sharing.</li> <li>Proactively research and integrate latest developments in ML and payer fraud prevention to drive innovation at GoCardless.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What excites you</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Being a self-starter who thrives on taking a vague business problem and owning the journey from the first prototype to a live, measurable solution.</li> <li>An opportunity to introduce and scale advanced architectures to solve high-stakes fraud and payment challenges.</li> <li>Moving beyond execution to help define the technical roadmap for Payer Fraud Prevention, ensuring we leverage the best tools for the job.</li> <li>Building production-grade ML models on a streamlined GCP and Vertex AI stack to drive fintech innovation.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What excites us</strong></h3> <ul> <li>You hold a degree (or PhD) in a STEM discipline or an equivalent commercial experience.</li> <li>You bring hands-on experience with sophisticated architectures, such as deep learning, graph-based, or sequence-based models (experience in Fintech, Fraud Prevention, or Payments is a big plus).</li> <li>You can translate complex ML concepts into practical product solutions and communicate these ideas clearly to non-technical peers.</li> <li>You are comfortable owning the full lifecycle, from deep-dive analysis and feature engineering to prototyping, validation, and live A/B testing.</li> <li>You lead by example, writing clean, high-quality code and raising the team’s technical bar through knowledge sharing and code best practices.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Base salary range:</strong> £99,200 - £148,800</p> <p> </p> <p>Base salary ranges are based on role, job level, location, and market data.  Please note that whilst we strive to offer competitive compensation, our approach is to pay between the <span style="text-decoration: underline;">minimum and the mid-point</span> of the pay range until performance can be assessed in role. Offers will take into account level of experience, interview assessment, budgets and parity between you and fellow employees at GoCardless doing similar work.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3><strong>(some of) The good stuff</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Wellbeing </strong>- stay healthy with dedicated support and medical cover</li> <li><strong>Work away scheme</strong> - gives you the option to work away from your country of residence for up to 90 days in any 12 month period</li> <li><strong>Adaptive Working</strong> - allows you to work flexibly, around your lifestyle</li> <li><strong>Parental leave</strong> - to suit everyone embarking on life's great adventure</li> <li><strong>Learning Budget</strong> - lead your own development with an annual learning budget</li> <li><strong>Time off</strong> - generous holiday allowance, + 3 annual volunteer days, + 4 annual business-wide wellness days (‘GC Fridays’)</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Life at GoCardless  </strong></h3> <p>We're an organisation defined by our <a href="https://gocardless.com/g/values-operating-principles/">values</a>; We <em>start with why </em>before we begin any project, to ensure it’s aligned with our mission. We<em> act with integrity</em>, always. We <em>care deeply</em> about what we do and we know it's essential that we <em>be humble </em>whilst we do it. Working this way creates the GC magic- the reason we all love showing up to work. </p> <h3><strong>Diversity & Inclusion</strong></h3> <p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal leading-[1.7]">As of April 2025, we had 806 employees (GeeCees) globally, with 524 based in the UK, 163 based in Latvia and 119 across our other offices.</p> <p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal leading-[1.7]">To ensure that we're representative of the world around us - and to be able to review relevant benchmarks - we ask GeeCees to voluntarily disclose diversity data. This year, the proportion of GeeCees providing data increased to 88% (up from 79% in 2024). title: Senior Lease Administration Analyst
description: <div class="content-intro"><div> <div> <div class="gmail_quote"> <div> <div><span id="m_-113912706363268805m_-2746164444908759431gmail-docs-internal-guid-131e4fb0-7fff-b4e9-ff50-e8cf32449b1b">CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Built for pioneers by pioneers, CoreWeave delivers a platform of technology, tools, and teams that enables innovators to build and scale AI with confidence. Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at <a href="https://www.coreweave.com">www.coreweave.com</a>.</span></div> <div> </div> <div>We're proud to be a Living Wage accredited Employer.</div> </div> </div> </div> </div> <p> </p></div><h2><strong>About the Role</strong></h2> <p>CoreWeave is seeking a Data Center Senior Lease Analyst to support the administration, accuracy, and ongoing optimization of our growing data center, real estate, and equipment lease portfolio. In this role, you will own complex lease administration activities, maintain lease data integrity, support ASC 842 / IFRS 16 and SOX compliance, and improve reporting and controls within our lease management system, CoStar.</p> <p>You’ll partner closely with Accounting, Finance, Operations, Tax, Legal, and external landlords and brokers to ensure lease obligations are accurately captured, payments are processed appropriately, and critical dates and contractual requirements are effectively managed. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys interpreting complex agreements, solving problems, and improving processes in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.</p> <h2><strong>What You’ll Do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Own lease abstraction and interpretation for complex and non-standard data center, real estate, and equipment leases.</li> <li>Review and approve lease abstractions and data entry completed by Lease Analysts and third-party providers, providing quality-control sign-off.</li> <li>Manage critical lease dates, including renewals, terminations, escalations, and notice deadlines.</li> <li>Coordinate with Accounts Payable and DC leadership to ensure timely and accurate lease payments and approvals.</li> <li>Partner with landlords and brokers to resolve billing disputes, reconcile CAM, operating expenses, and tax charges, and confirm lease commencement and rent commencement dates.</li> <li>Perform desk audits of annual operating expense statements to validate charges against lease terms.</li> <li>Interpret complex commercial lease provisions related to rent, taxes, insurance, power usage, cross-connects, and other contractual obligations.</li> <li>Support lease negotiations, amendments, and legal redlines by providing lease administration expertise and historical context.</li> <li>Maintain accurate lease data in CoStar, identify data quality issues, and implement improvements to strengthen controls and reporting.</li> <li>Support ASC 842, IFRS 16, and SOX compliance, including internal and external audit requests, documentation, and data validation.</li> <li>Prepare and distribute recurring and ad hoc reports, KPI dashboards, critical-date trackers, and briefing materials for internal stakeholders and leadership.</li> <li>Serve as a primary point of contact for landlord and broker relationships, including escalations and issue resolution.</li> <li>Build strong relationships with Accounting, Finance, Operations, Tax, and Legal to ensure timely and accurate lease information.</li> <li>Train, mentor, and provide quality oversight for Lease Analysts.</li> <li>Drive continuous improvement across lease administration workflows, reporting, controls, and system utilization.</li> <li>Serve as backup to the Lease Administration Manager during absences, including approvals, escalations, and time-sensitive decisions.</li> <li>Support Tax with VAT recovery activities as needed by region.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Who You Are</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, Real Estate, or a related field.</li> <li>5+ years of commercial real estate lease administration experience, preferably supporting data centers or other complex infrastructure portfolios.</li> <li>Strong understanding of ASC 842 / IRFS 16 and lease accounting principles.</li> <li>Demonstrated experience reviewing, interpreting, and administering complex commercial lease agreements and amendments.</li> <li>Strong analytical skills and attention to detail, with experience identifying discrepancies and resolving complex lease or billing issues.</li> <li>Ability to manage multiple priorities and critical deadlines in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.</li> <li>Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively across Finance, Accounting, Operations, Legal, and external partners.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Preferred:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience with CoStar or a similar lease administration platform.</li> <li>Experience with Asana and Google Workspace.</li> <li>Familiarity with SOX controls and IFRS 16.</li> <li>Data center or infrastructure-related lease administration experience.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Wondering if you’re a good fit? We believe in investing in our people, and value candidates who can bring their own diversified experiences to our teams – even if you aren't a 100% skill or experience match. Here are a few qualities we’ve found compatible with our team. If some of this describes you, we’d love to talk.</strong></p> <ul> <li>You possess excellent communication, organisational, and analytical skills.</li> <li>You are able to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.</li> <li>You have a proactive mindset with a track record of identifying gaps and driving solutions.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Why CoreWeave?</strong></h2> <p>At CoreWeave, we work hard, have fun, and move fast! We’re in an exciting stage of hyper-growth that you will not want to miss out on. We’re not afraid of a little chaos, and we’re constantly learning. Our team cares deeply about how we build our product and how we work together, which is represented through our core values:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Be Curious at Your Core</strong></li> <li><strong>Act Like an Owner</strong></li> <li><strong>Empower Employees</strong></li> <li><strong>Deliver Best-in-Class Client Experiences</strong></li> <li><strong>Achieve More Together</strong></li> </ul> <p>We support and encourage an entrepreneurial outlook and independent thinking. We foster an environment that encourages collaboration and enables the development of innovative solutions to complex problems. As we get set for takeoff, the growth opportunities within the organization are constantly expanding. You will be surrounded by some of the best talent in the industry, who will want to learn from you, too. Come join us!</p> <p>The starting salary will be determined by job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and the market location. We strive for both market alignment and internal equity when determining compensation. In addition to base salary, our total rewards package includes a discretionary bonus, equity awards, and a comprehensive benefits program (all based on eligibility).</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><em>To fulfill our obligation to protect client data, successful applicants offered employment with CoreWeave will be required to complete a basic criminal record check, conducted in compliance with GDPR. Employment offers are conditional upon receiving satisfactory check results.</em></p> <p><strong>What We Offer</strong></p> <p>In addition to a competitive salary, we offer a variety of benefits to support your needs, including:</p> <ul> <li>Family-level Medical Insurance</li> <li>Family-level Dental Insurance </li> <li>Generous Pension Contribution </li> <li>Life Assurance at 4x Salary </li> <li>Critical Illness Cover </li> <li>Employee Assistance Programme </li> <li>Tuition Reimbursement</li> <li>Work culture focused on innovative disruption</li> </ul> <p><em>Benefits may vary by location. </em></p> <p><strong>Equal Opportunity </strong></p> <p><em>CoreWeave is an equal opportunity employer, committed to fostering an inclusive and supportive workplace. All qualified applicants and candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or genetic information.</em></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;"><strong>Recruitment Agencies</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;"><em><em data-stringify-type="italic">CoreWeave does not accept speculative CVs. Any unsolicited CVs received will be treated as the property of CoreWeave and your Terms & Conditions associated with the use of CVs will be considered null and void.</em></em></span></p> <p><em><span style="font-weight: 400;"><em data-stringify-type="italic">Any unsolicited CVs sent by your company to us – that is to say, in any situation where we have not directly engaged your company in writing to supply candidates for a specific vacancy – will be considered by us to be a “free gift”, leaving us liable for no fees whatsoever should we choose to contact the candidate directly and engage the candidate’s services, and will in no way establish any prior claim by your company to representation of that candidate should the candidate’s details also be submitted by any other party.</em></span></em></p> <p><strong>Export Control Compliance</strong></p> <p>This position requires access to export controlled information.  To conform to U.S. Government export regulations applicable to that information, applicant must either be (A) a U.S. person, defined as a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful permanent resident (green card holder), (iii) refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, (B) eligible to access the export controlled information without a required export authorization, or (C) eligible and reasonably likely to obtain the required export authorization from the applicable U.S. government agency.  CoreWeave may, for legitimate business reasons, decline to pursue any export licensing process.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong><em>Updated privacy notice - UK and EU Job Applications </em></strong></p> <p><em>When you apply to a job on this site, the personal data conta

12 months, you will:</p> <ul> <li>Define the EMEA startup business development strategy, operating plan and investment priorities.</li> <li>Develop and launch CoreWeave’s proposition for AI startups
